notes:
Identity assessment: the canonical text identifies SOURCE https://osf.io/download/tywer/, title Replication of a Research Claim from Netemyer et al., (2018), from The Journal of Consumer Research; replication team Mitch Metzger and Peter R. Mallik; research scientist Melissa Kline; Final report, August 14, 2020. The repository identifies Netemeyer_JournConsRes_2018_Ow0 - Metzger_46z8 - Direct Replication; the references identify Netemeyer et al. (2018), How am I doing?, Journal of Consumer Research 45, 68-89. This is a primary final replication report at the supplied URL, not an abstract or preregistration. The supplied reference’s November 18, 2025 date and additional Loomas/Miske authorship are not confirmed by the document. No PDF supplied. The input supplies no replication locator, study identifier, or neutral description. The report claim statement mentions both the frame-by-scale interaction and the CMMS frame comparison, and results report several tests. The report calls CMMS the main claim, but that does not establish which test this assigned row targets. Multiple printed Cohen’s d tests remain candidates. No numerical matching or row-order inference was used.
